'''Trellik Hive''' was a [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] hive during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The Trellik hive was ruled by [[Duke/Legends|Duke]] [[Dimmock]], a chief rival of [[Gogum Hive]].<ref name="Long Arm">{{FFG|story=The Long Arm of the Hutt|book=Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Beginner Game|text=''Star Wars: Edge of the Empire'' Beginner Game}}</ref>
